_comment: Per-game notes, as DATA: the source of GAMES.md's 'Status at a glance' table, which
packaging/gen_games_table.py generates from here. The long-form sections of GAMES.md stay
A game counts as verified only once it has been driven over raw USB. Results from the old
shim (v0.1.0) do not carry over, so those games are back to untested.
'sends_ffb' is true / false / null, and null means UNKNOWN. Do not guess it.

games.name: DiRT 4
games.summary: Steering, pedals and force feedback all work: the wheel loads up in a corner and pulls back to centre.
games.setup_summary: Yes, vJoy must be registered as a wheel
quirks: vJoy must be registered as a wheel in the game's device_defines.xml. Without it DiRT 4 sends unsigned magnitude with no usable direction: the wheel pulls one way and never centres, while kerbs and gravel still feel correct, which is what makes it easy to misdiagnose.

Steering is declared in an action map XML so a fresh install has working steering without touching the settings screen. Rebinding it in the game's own UI also works, once vJoy is registered as a wheel.
Steam's 'Verify integrity of game files' removes both files, and so does a game update. Expect to reapply them.
invert must stay true. Measured: DiRT 4's force points the SAME way as the steering angle, so applied unchanged it is positive feedback and the wheel runs away into the corner.

games.name: RaceRoom Racing Experience
games.summary: Worked with the old shim; not yet driven over raw USB.
games.setup_summary: No, just bind steering in the game
quirks: RaceRoom asks for effects it never uses. It opens one constant force on block 1 and six sine effects on blocks 2 to 7, then stops all seven and restarts only the constant one. The sines are never started, and this wheel's firmware is silent on periodics anyway.
It sends duration 0xFFFF, the HID PID code for 'until I say stop', where DiRT 4 sends 0. The bridge reads it as infinite.

games.name: Automobilista 2 Demo
games.summary: Worked with the old shim; not yet driven over raw USB.
quirks: Set Controller Damping to 0 in Options > Controls > Configuration. At 100, which is where the Custom Wheel preset can leave it, steering is completely dead on track while the menus, calibration, pedals and force feedback all look perfect.

Throttle bleeds into steering, and the game applies a centre deadzone that calibration does not show. Neither is ours: AMS2 treats a wheel it does not recognise as a gamepad and applies gamepad filtering, which is speed dependent.
It sends one constant force plus sine effects it never starts at gain 0, with duration 0xFFFF, the same infinite sentinel RaceRoom uses.
